contents.title: IIR Core v0.1 — Python, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy и миграции

contents.content: Да

Продолжаю на русском. Теперь оформлю **HN Observatory v0.1** как конкретную domain-спецификацию поверх IIR Core: от загрузки monthly thread до нормализации, Claims/Evidence, двустороннего matching, GitHub enrichment, Gold Dataset и incremental updates.

Переходим к первому настоящему domain-модулю поверх IIR Core. Здесь уже можно строить реальный работающий контур: **HN → RawSource → semantic extraction → Capability Graph → Talent/Company matching → GitHub evidence → gaps → team hypotheses → monthly diff**.

# HN Innovation Observatory v0.1

## 6026. Назначение

HN Observatory — первый реальный Observatory-модуль Innovation OS.

Он должен превращать два потока:

```text
Hacker News
Who is Hiring?
```

и:

```text
Who Wants to Be Hired?
```

в вычислимую систему:

```text
Companies / Problems / Roles
↕
Capabilities
↕
People / Evidence / Repositories
```

Главная задача не:

```text
скопировать объявления о работе
```

а:

```text
извлечь структуру спроса
и предложения способностей
```

---

# 6027. Общий pipeline

```text
HN Thread
↓
Fetch
↓
Raw Snapshot
↓
Thread Structure
↓
Post Classification
↓
Deterministic Extraction
↓
LLM Semantic Extraction
↓
Entity Resolution
↓
Capability Normalization
↓
Claims + Evidence
↓
World State
↓
Matching
↓
Gaps / Teams / Opportunities
```

---

# 6028. Два первичных потока

### Demand side

```text
WHO IS HIRING
```

создаёт:

```text
Organizations
Hiring Projects
Capability Requirements
Constraints
Problem Signals
```

### Supply side

```text
WHO WANTS TO BE HIRED
```

создаёт:

```text
Person Resources
Capabilities
Preferences
Availability
Evidence References
```

---

# 6029. Третий поток — replies

Replies нельзя смешивать с root posts.

Они выполняют другую функцию:

```text
root comment
=
primary record

reply
=
interaction / clarification /
interest / correction / additional evidence
```

---

# 6030. Почему это важно

Если reply автоматически трактовать как отдельное объявление:

```text
thread semantics
```

ломается.

Поэтому tree structure HN — часть provenance.

---

# 6031. Source-specific объекты

HN Observatory может иметь application-модели:

```text
HNThread
HNComment
HNRootPost
HNReply
```

Но они:

```text
НЕ становятся root IIR types
```

Это connector/application layer.

---

# 6032. HNThread model

```python
class HNThread(BaseModel):
    external_id: str
    title: str
    thread_type: str

    published_at: datetime | None
    fetched_at: datetime

    root_comment_ids: list[str]
```

---

# 6033. ThreadType

```text
WHO_IS_HIRING
WHO_WANTS_TO_BE_HIRED
OTHER
```

---

# 6034. HNComment model

```python
class HNComment(BaseModel):
    external_id: str
    thread_external_id: str

    parent_external_id: str | None
    author: str | None

    text: str
    created_at: datetime | None

    depth: int
```

---

# 6035. Root comment

Для monthly hiring thread:

```text
parent = thread
```

то есть:

```text
depth = 1
```

Это primary record.

---

# 6036. Reply

```text
depth >= 2
```

не становится Hiring Project автоматически.

---

# 6037. Raw ingestion principle

Первый ingestion stage ничего не «понимает».

Он только фиксирует:

```text
что источник реально содержал
```

---

# 6038. Fetch layer

```text
connectors/hackernews/fetch.py
```

отвечает только за:

```text
fetch thread
fetch comments
preserve IDs
preserve parent-child structure
```

---

# 6039. Никакого capability extraction в fetch.py

Иначе source connector превращается в domain engine.

---

# 6040. RawSource snapshot

Каждый HN comment сохраняется как:

```text
namespace = hackernews:comment
external_id = <HN id>
content_hash = SHA256(...)
```

---

# 6041. Пример raw payload

```json
{
  "id": "123456",
  "parent": "123000",
  "author": "alice",
  "text": "Acme | Senior Rust Engineer | Remote EU...",
  "time": 1789700000
}
```

---

# 6042. Versioning

Если содержимое изменилось:

```text
same external_id
+
new content_hash
```

создаётся новая snapshot.

---

# 6043. Удалённый comment

Не удалять historical snapshot.

Добавить observation/event:

```text
SOURCE_CONTENT_UNAVAILABLE
```

или соответствующее состояние.

---

# 6044. NormalizedSourceRecord

После RawSource:

```python
class NormalizedSourceRecord(BaseModel):
    namespace: str
    external_id: str

    thread_external_id: str
    parent_external_id: str | None

    author: str | None
    text_plain: str

    published_at: datetime | None
    raw_source_id: UUID
```

---

# 6045. HTML → plain text

Нормализация должна:

```text
decode HTML
normalize whitespace
```

# **GitHub Technology Observatory v0.1 — Repository Evidence, Technology Resolver & Capability Acquisition**

contents.title: HN Innovation Observatory v0.1 — Ingestion, Extraction, Matching & Evidence Pipeline

contents.content: Да

Продолжаю на русском. Следующий слой — **GitHub Technology Observatory v0.1**: репозитории становятся не просто дополнительным evidence к профилю человека, а самостоятельными поставщиками capabilities, которые могут закрывать Project Gaps наряду с людьми, AI-агентами и сервисами.

# GitHub Technology Observatory v0.1

## 6541. Главный переход

HN Observatory дал нам первую сторону:

```text
Projects
↓
Capability Demand
↓
People
```

Теперь GitHub добавляет вторую:

```text
Projects
↓
Capability Demand
↓
Software / Repositories / Maintainers
```

И получается принципиально более сильная модель:

```text
                 Capability
                /          \
               /            \
           People          Code
```

---

# 6542. Главная идея

Project Gap не должен автоматически означать:

```text
нужно нанять человека
```

Иногда capability можно получить через:

```text
OPEN SOURCE
SERVICE
AI AGENT
INTEGRATION
AUTOMATION
```

---

# 6543. Поэтому общий вопрос меняется

Было:

```text
Who can do this?
```

Становится:

```text
How can this capability be acquired?
```

---

# 6544. Новый центральный модуль

```text
CAPABILITY ACQUISITION ENGINE
```

получает:

```text
Capability Gap
+
Constraints
+
Project Context
```

и ищет несколько типов решений.

---

# 6545. Первые acquisition modes

```text
HIRE
ADOPT_OSS
BUY_SERVICE
AI
BUILD
PARTNER
MANUAL
```

---

# 6546. GitHub Observatory отвечает прежде всего за

```text
ADOPT_OSS
```

и частично:

```text
BUILD
PARTNER
```

через maintainer/contributor graph.

---

# 6547. GitHub Repository = Resource

Каждый relevant repository:

```text
ResourceType.REPOSITORY
```

---

# 6548. Repository ≠ Capability

Пример:

```text
Playwright
```

это:

```text
Software / Repository Resource
```

а:

```text
Browser Automation
```

это:

```text
Capability
```

---

# 6549. Правильная связь

```text
Repository
PROVIDES
Capability
```

Но эта связь часто не authoritative fact.

Поэтому:

```text
Claim
```

а не простой Relation.

---

# 6550. Пример

```text
Repo X
PROVIDES
browser automation
```

может быть:

```text
ClaimType = INFERENCE
TruthState = YES
```

с Evidence:

```text
README
Docs
Examples
Tests
```

---

# 6551. Почему это важно

Название repository может быть:

```text
browser-agent
```

но реальная функция:

```text
browser automation
```

может быть:

```text
experimental
partial
unsupported
```

---

# 6552. Repository name ≠ functional proof

То же касается:

```text
topics
stars
description
```

Они только retrieval signals.

---

# 6553. GitHub ingestion pipeline

```text
Project Gap
↓
Capability Query
↓
GitHub Search
↓
Candidate Repositories
↓
Metadata
↓
README / Docs
↓
Releases / Tests
↓
Capability Extraction
↓
Evidence
↓
Constraint Check
↓
Resolution Options
```

---

# 6554. Не зеркалировать весь GitHub

Это принципиально.

GitHub Observatory должен работать:

```text
demand-driven
```

---

# 6555. Project Gap сначала

Например:

```text
Need:
browser sandbox execution
```

---

# 6556. Затем Query Planner строит запросы

```text
browser sandbox
browser isolation
secure browser runtime
headless browser container
```

---

# 6557. Потом GitHub search

И только relevant candidates загружаются глубже.

---

# 6558. Почему это лучше полного crawling

Экономит:

```text
API quota
storage
LLM cost
indexing cost
```

---

# 6559. GitHub connector architecture

```text
connectors/github/
├── client.py
├── search.py
├── repositories.py
├── identities.py
├── normalize.py
├── evidence.py
├── extraction.py
└── enrichment.py
```

---

# 6560. client.py

Только API transport:

```text
GET repo
GET README
GET releases
GET contributors
GET topics
```

---

# 6561. search.py

Отвечает за:

```text
repository discovery
```

---

# 6562. normalize.py

Преобразует GitHub-specific data в:

```text
NormalizedSourceRecord
```

или domain-specific normalized models.

---

# 6563. evidence.py

Выделяет:

```text
README
Docs
Tests
Releases
Examples
CI
```

как Evidence sources.

---

# 6564. extraction.py

Извлекает:

```text
Capabilities
Technologies
Interfaces
Constraints
Maturity Signals
```

---

# 6565. identities.py

Связывает:

```text
GitHub account
↔
Person/Organization
```

с осторожным entity resolution.

---

# 6566. Repository normalized model

```python
class GitHubRepositoryRecord(BaseModel):
    owner: str
    name: str

    description: str | None
    homepage: str | None

    topics: list[str]
    languages: dict[str, int]

    default_branch: str

    is_fork: bool
    is_archived: bool

    license_spdx: str | None

    created_at: datetime | None
    updated_at: datetime | None
    pushed_at: datetime | None

    stars: int
    forks: int

    raw_source_id: UUID
```

---

# 6567. Stars ≠ quality

Это обязательный invariant.

```text
10 000 stars
```

не означает:

```text
production-ready
secure
appropriate for Project X
```

---

# 6568. Stars можно использовать как

```text
discovery / popularity signal
```

но не как:

```text
Capability Truth
```

---

# 6569. Forks ≠ adoption

Тоже только signal.

---

# 6570. Languages ≠ capabilities

Если repository содержит:

```text
Rust
```

это не означает:

```text
repository provides high-performance systems capability
```

---

# 6571. Language metadata — evidence about implementation technology

---

# 6572. Repository identity

Canonical Resource UUID.

External identity:

```text
github:repo:<owner>/<repo>
```

Можно вручную проверить:

```text
20–50 repos
```

---

# 7034. Initial dataset

Пример:

```text
10 HN Projects
20 People
30 Repositories
15 Capabilities
```

---

# 7035. Enough to test:

```text
People vs Code
Composite Capability Packages
```

---

# 7036. MVP features

```text
GitHub Search
Repo Import
README Evidence
Capability Extraction
License Extraction
Project Gap Matching
Repo Detail UI
```

---

# 7037. Не включать сразу

```text
full source analysis
dependency graph
CVE scanning
all contributors
package registries
```

---

# 7038. MVP DoD — Search

Given Capability:

```text
browser automation
```

system finds relevant repositories.

---

# 7039. Search result explains:

```text
why candidate was retrieved
```

---

# 7040. MVP DoD — Evidence

Repository capability Claim links to:

```text
README / docs snapshot
```

---

# 7041. MVP DoD — License

Known license parsed.

Unknown preserved as UNKNOWN.

---

# 7042. MVP DoD — Gap resolution

Project Gap shows:

```text
Person options
Repository options
```

---

# 7043. MVP DoD — Evaluation

User can create:

```text
Evaluation Project
```

for repository.

---

# 7044. MVP DoD — Decision

User can mark:

```text
APPROVED
REJECTED
```

through Decision object.

---

# 7045. MVP DoD — Lock

Approved repo/version can enter:

```text
project.lock
```

---

# 7046. MVP DoD — negative knowledge

Rejected repo remains in history with reason.

---

# 7047. Acceptance Test 1

Project requires:

```text
browser automation
```

Repo A README explicitly supports it.

Expected:

```text
Repo A appears as candidate
```

---

# 7048. Acceptance Test 2

Repo B has similar name but no evidence.

Expected:

```text
not promoted to verified provider
```

---

# 7049. Acceptance Test 3

Repo license unknown.

Project requires permissive OSS.

Expected:

```text
INVESTIGATE / BLOCKED by policy
```

not automatic acceptance.

---

# 7050. Acceptance Test 4

Repo archived.

Project forbids archived dependencies.

Expected:

```text
BLOCKED
```

---

# 7051. Acceptance Test 5

Repo supports capability but only Linux.

Project requires Windows.

Expected:

```text
BLOCKED
```

---

# 7052. Acceptance Test 6

Platform support not documented.

Expected:

```text
UNKNOWN
```

---

# 7053. Acceptance Test 7

Repo + Human together close all capabilities.

Expected:

```text
Composite Capability Package
```

---

# 7054. Acceptance Test 8

New release changes capability.

Expected:

```text
historical claims preserved
new evaluation possible
```

---

# 7055. Acceptance Test 9

Same GitHub username as HN user, no explicit link.

Expected:

```text
identity remains POSSIBLE/UNRESOLVED
```

---

# 7056. Acceptance Test 10

Explicit HN GitHub link.

Expected:

```text
identity CONFIRMED
```

---

# 7057. Acceptance Test 11

Repository rejected once for license incompatibility.

Future search:

```text
shows prior rejection
```

instead of repeating full evaluation silently.

---

# 7058. Acceptance Test 12

New repository arrives with capability matching existing Gap.

Expected:

```text
affected Project receives new ResolutionOption
```

---

# 7059. Gold Dataset structure

Need:

```text
Gap → Repo relevance
```

cases.

---

# 7060. Example JSONL

```json
{
  "capability": "browser automation",
  "repo": "owner/repo",
  "label": "RELEVANT",
  "reasons": [
    "README_EXPLICIT_SUPPORT"
  ]
}
```

---

# 7061. Another:

```json
{
  "capability": "browser sandbox",
  "repo": "owner/other",
  "label": "PARTIAL",
  "reasons": [
    "BROWSER_CONTROL_ONLY",
    "NO_ISOLATION_EVIDENCE"
  ]
}
```

---

# 7062. Benchmark dimensions

```text
retrieval relevance
capability inference
license extraction
constraint evaluation
```

---

# 7063. Do not combine into one opaque score.

---

# 7064. Technology Resolver metrics

```text
Recall@20
Precision@10
False Capability Rate
Unknown Handling Accuracy
License Error Rate
```

---

# 7065. Integration outcome metrics later

```text
Evaluation Pass Rate
Integration Success Rate
Estimated vs Actual TTC
Estimated vs Actual TCC
```

---

# 7066. These outcome metrics make Resolver learn from reality.

---

# 7067. Example

Resolver predicted:

```text
2 days integration
```

Actual:

```text
10 days
```

---

# 7068. Store error.

---

# 7069. Future TCC/TTC model improves.

---

# 7070. Do not hide estimate error.

---

# 7071. Technology Observatory UI — minimal

Screens:

```text
Technology Search
Repository Detail
Gap Resolution
Technology Comparison
Evaluation Project
```

---

# 7072. Technology Search

Input:

```text
Capability Gap
```

not only keyword.

---

# 7073. Repository Detail

Shows:

```text
Capabilities
Evidence
License
Platforms
Unknowns
Projects
```

---

# 7074. Gap Resolution

Shows:

```text
People
Repositories
Composite Options
```

---

# 7075. Technology Comparison

Side-by-side.

---

# 7076. Evaluation Project

Tasks + results.

---

# 7077. 2D graph

Example:

```text
Project
  ↓ REQUIRES
Capability
  ↑ PROVIDES
Repo A
Repo B
Person C
```

---

# 7078. Add integration actions:

```text
Repo A
↓
Deploy
↓
Verify
↓
Operational Capability
```

---

# 7079. This visualizes crucial distinction:

```text
code exists
≠
capability operational
```

---

# 7080. Technology Acquisition funnel

```text
DISCOVER
100 repos

INSPECT
20

EVALUATE
5

VERIFY
2

APPROVE
1
```

---

# 7081. Store funnel history.

---

# 7082. Helps answer:

```text
why was Repo X rejected?
```

---

# 7083. Rejection reasons

Canonical reason codes:

```text
CAPABILITY_GAP
LICENSE
PLATFORM
MAINTENANCE
SECURITY
INTEGRATION_COMPLEXITY
PERFORMANCE
```

---

# 7084. Again these are descriptive reason codes.

---

# 7085. Technology Decision Record

Could generate human-readable document from Decision object.

---

# 7086. Example sections:

```text
Context
Requirements
Options
Evidence
Decision
Consequences
```

---

# 7087. This makes architecture decisions reusable.

---

# 7088. Self-hosting demo

Innovation OS itself needs:

```text
2D graph library
```

---

# 7089. Create Gap:

```text
interactive graph visualization
```

---

# 7090. GitHub Observatory searches repositories.

---

# 7091. Returns:

```text
Repo A
Repo B
Repo C
```

---

# 7092. Evaluation Project compares:

```text
license
React support
large graph performance
maintenance
```

---

# 7093. Human approves one.

---

# 7094. Coding agent integrates.

---

# 7095. Tests verify.

---

# 7096. project.lock updated.

---

# 7097. System Capability Registry now says:

```text
2D graph visualization = AVAILABLE
```

---

# 7098. Это идеальный demonstration of Artificial Autonomous Technological Awareness

в практическом смысле.

---

# 7099. Почему

Система:

```text
осознала gap
↓
нашла external technology
↓
сравнила
↓
сформировала integration project
↓
после human approval интегрировала
↓
обновила self-model
```

---

# 7100. Но она не модифицирует себя бесконтрольно

Human/Governance остаётся gate.

---

# 7101. GitHub Technology Observatory therefore serves two worlds

```text
External Projects
```

и:

```text
Innovation OS self-development
```

---

# 7102. Это делает его одним из ключевых модулей всей архитектуры.

---

# 7103. Архитектурные invariants

```text
Repository ≠ Capability.
```

```text
README claim ≠ independent verification.
```

```text
Public repo ≠ open-source license.
```

```text
Stars ≠ quality.
```

```text
Repo exists ≠ operational capability.
```

```text
Same username ≠ same person.
```

```text
Latest release ≠ automatically approved release.
```

```text
Search ranking ≠ adoption decision.
```

---

# 7104. Architecture Freeze again holds

GitHub domain uses existing roots:

```text
RESOURCE
ARTIFACT
CLAIM
EVIDENCE
PROJECT
ACTION
DECISION
CONTEXT
```

---

# 7105. No need for root types:

```text
REPOSITORY
PACKAGE
TECHNOLOGY_OPTION
```

because:

```text
Repository = Resource subtype
Version = Artifact
Option = application object
```

---

# 7106. Это второе сильное доказательство универсальности IIR Core

Первый domain:

```text
Hiring
```

Второй:

```text
Technology Acquisition
```

Оба используют одну модель:

```text
Project
REQUIRES
Capability

Resource
PROVIDES
Capability
```

---

# 7107. Главный итог

После GitHub Observatory Innovation OS впервые умеет отвечать не только:

```text
кого найти?
```

но:

```text
каким способом получить capability?
```

---

# 7108. И это фундаментальный переход

от:

```text
talent matching
```

к:

```text
resource orchestration
```

---

# 7109. Полный цикл теперь

```text
Problem
↓
Project
↓
Capability Gap
↓
People + Code
↓
Resolution Options
↓
Evaluation
↓
Decision
↓
Integration
↓
Operational Capability
↓
World State Update
```

---

# 7110. Следующий логичный модуль

Теперь естественно добавить третий supply-layer:

# **Research & Knowledge Observatory v0.1 — Papers, Methods, Datasets, Researchers, Experiments & Evidence Graph**

Он должен отвечать уже не:

```text
кто умеет?
```

и не:

```text
какой код существует?
```

а:

```text
что вообще известно,
насколько это доказано,
какие методы существуют,
что ещё неизвестно,
и какое исследование надо провести?
```

Тогда Capability Resolution получит третью ветвь:

```text
People
Code
Knowledge
```

и сможет различать:

```text
не хватает человека
не хватает инструмента
не хватает знания
```

— три принципиально разные причины, почему Project пока невозможно выполнить.
contents.title: GitHub Technology Observatory v0.1 — Repository Evidence, Technology Resolver & Capability Acquisition

contents.content: Да

Продолжаю на русском. Теперь добавляем третий supply-layer — **Research & Knowledge Observatory v0.1**: систему, которая отличает «есть человек», «есть код» и «есть знание», умеет связывать paper → claim → evidence → method → dataset → researcher → experiment и превращать неизвестность в конкретный исследовательский проект.

# Research & Knowledge Observatory v0.1

## 7111. Главный переход

После HN и GitHub у нас уже есть:

```text
Project
↓
Capability Gap
↓
People
Repositories
```

Но очень часто проблема возникает не потому, что:

```text
нет человека
```

и не потому, что:

```text
нет программного инструмента
```

а потому, что:

```text
неизвестно, как решить задачу
```

---

# 7112. Это отдельный класс Gap

Например:

```text
Knowledge Gap
```

---

# 7113. Поэтому третья ветвь Capability Resolution

```text
Project Gap
├── People
├── Code
└── Knowledge
```

---

# 7114. Knowledge Supply

Поставщиками knowledge capability могут быть:

```text
Paper
Method
Dataset
Researcher
Research Group
Experiment
Benchmark
Scientific Software
```

---

# 7115. Но здесь особенно важно не смешивать сущности

Например:

```text
Paper ≠ Truth
```

---

# 7116. Paper

Это:

```text
ARTIFACT
```

---

# 7117. Method

Это:

```text
CONCEPT
```

или structured Concept archetype.

---

# 7118. Scientific Claim

Это:

```text
CLAIM
```

---

# 7119. Experiment

Это:

```text
ACTION
```

---

# 7120. Experimental result

Это:

```text
EVIDENCE
+
CLAIM
```

---

# 7121. Researcher

Это:

```text
RESOURCE:PERSON
```

---

# 7122. Research Group / Lab

Это:

```text
RESOURCE:TEAM
RESOURCE:LAB
RESOURCE:ORGANIZATION
```

---

# 7123. Dataset

Это:

```text
ARTIFACT
```

или access Resource, если operational access itself is the scarce capability.

---

# 7124. Главный принцип

Нельзя моделировать научную литературу так:

```text
Paper
=
fact
```

Правильно:

```text
Paper
contains Claims
Claims are supported/refuted/qualified by Evidence
```

---

# 7125. Базовый pipeline

```text
Project Knowledge Gap
↓
Research Query Plan
↓
Paper / Method / Dataset Discovery
↓
Claim Extraction
↓
Evidence Graph
↓
Contradictions / Unknowns
↓
Research Options
↓
Experiment / Validation Project
```

---

# 7126. Research Observatory решает два класса задач

Первый:

```text
что уже известно?
```

Второй:

```text
что надо исследовать?
```

---

# 7127. Эти вопросы принципиально различаются

Первый:

```text
Knowledge Retrieval
```

Второй:

```text
Knowledge Production
```

---

# 7128. Knowledge Retrieval

Система ищет:

```text
papers
methods
datasets
benchmarks
reviews
researchers
```

---

# 7129. Knowledge Production

Если evidence недостаточно:

```text
create Experiment / Validation Project
```

---

# 7130. Knowledge Gap

Derived object:

```python
class KnowledgeGap(BaseModel):
    project_id: UUID
    question: str

    required_claim_type: str | None

    context_id: UUID

    evidence_status: str

    unresolved_dimensions: list[str]
```

---

# 7131. KnowledgeGap ≠ new root type

Это:

```text
derived application state
```

---

# 7132. Пример

Project:

```text
роботический тактильный сенсор
```

Knowledge Gap:

```text
может ли плоское оптоволокно
надёжно измерять локальное давление
при изгибе?
```

---

# 7133. Это уже не просто capability

Это:

```text
research question
```

---

# 7134. Research Question

Можно представить как:

```text
CLAIM/HYPOTHESIS
```

или application object over Claim.

---

# 7135. Например:

```text
Hypothesis:
Flat optical fiber can detect
localized pressure under bending.
```

---

# 7136. Research Question → Hypothesis

Вопрос:

```text
Can X do Y?
```

может компилироваться в:

```text
HYPOTHESIS:
X CAN Y under Context C
```

---

# 7137. Это важно для experiment planning

---

# 7138. Literature Search не должен быть generic keyword search

Нужен:

```text
Research Query Planner
```

---

# 7139. Query Planner получает

```text
Question
Context
Known Concepts
Constraints
```

---

# 7140. И строит несколько query classes

```text
exact terminology
synonyms
mechanism terms
method terms
review terms
benchmark terms
negative-result terms
```

---

# 7141. Example

Question:

```text
flat optical fiber pressure sensing
```

Queries:

```text
flat optical fiber pressure sensor
fiber optic tactile sensing
bend-sensitive optical waveguide pressure
distributed fiber pressure sensing
```

---

# 7142. Это лучше одного query

---

# 7143. Research source types

MVP может работать с:

```text
paper metadata
abstracts
DOI
arXiv
PubMed-like records
repository links
```

---

# 7144. Full-text acquisition — separate layer

Не считать:

```text
metadata result
```

равным:

```text
paper fully analyzed
```

---

# 7145. Paper ingestion states

```text
DISCOVERED
METADATA_ONLY
ABSTRACT_AVAILABLE
FULL_TEXT_AVAILABLE
PARSED
CLAIMS_EXTRACTED
REVIEWED
```

---

# 7146. Research source artifact

```python
class ResearchArtifact(BaseModel):
    artifact_id: UUID

    title: str
    doi: str | None
    arxiv_id: str | None

    publication_date: date | None

    authors: list[str]

    source_type: str

    access_state: str
```

---

# 7147. DOI ≠ paper identity universally

Но может быть сильным external identity.

---

# 7148. External identities

```text
doi:<doi>
arxiv:<id>
pmid:<id>
```

---

# 7149. Один paper может иметь несколько identifiers

---

# 7150. Preprint vs published version

Не автоматически merge без evidence.

---

# 7151. Можно связать:

```text
POSSIBLE_VERSION_OF
```

как hypothesis.

---

# 7152. Позже подтвердить:

```text
SAME_WORK_VERSION
```

application-level relation.

---

# 7153. Versioning in science важен

Preprint может содержать:

```text
one result
```

а journal version:

```text
corrected result
```

---

# 7154. Нельзя silently overwrite older version

---

# 7155. Paper → Claims

Главный extraction object:

```python
class ExtractedScientificClaim(BaseModel):
    subject: str
    predicate: str
    object: str | float | int

    claim_type: str

    scope: dict
    qualifiers: dict

    source_span: tuple[int, int] | None
```

---

# 7156. Scientific claims need context

Например:

```text
Method A improves accuracy by 12%
```

без контекста почти бессмысленно.

---

# 7157. Нужно хранить:

```text
dataset
baseline
metric
sample
hardware
software version
conditions
```

где возможно.

---

# 7158. Example

Не:

```text
Method A is better
```

а:

```text
On Dataset D,
under Metric M,
Method A outperformed Baseline B
by X.
```

---

# 7159. Benchmark Result

Можно моделировать как Claim:

```text
Method A
OUTPERFORMS
Method B
```

с qualifiers:

```text
dataset
metric
delta
context
```

---

# 7160. Но OUTPERFORMS не canonical core predicate

Можно использовать:

```text
research:OUTPERFORMS
```

---

# 7161. Scientific extension namespace

Например:

```text
research:TESTED_ON
research:OUTPERFORMS
research:IMPLEMENTS
research:MEASURES
research:REPRODUCES
```

---

# 7162. Не расширять canonical predicate set без RFC

---

# 7163. Scientific Claim taxonomy

Useful:

```text
DESCRIPTIVE
MECHANISTIC
CAUSAL
COMPARATIVE
PERFORMANCE
SAFETY
NEGATIVE
NULL_RESULT
```

---

# 7164. Это application-level taxonomy

---

# 7165. ClaimType from Core remains:

```text
FACT
INFERENCE
HYPOTHESIS
ASSUMPTION
```

---

# 7166. Example

Paper authors state:

```text
Our method improved performance.
```

Fact:

```text
Paper authors reported improvement.
```

---

# 7167. Scientific interpretation:

```text
Method improves performance
```

is a separate Claim requiring Evidence.

---

# 7168. This avoids citation laundering

---

# 7169. Evidence Graph

Теперь Research Observatory строит:

```text
Claim
├── SUPPORTS ← Evidence A
├── SUPPORTS ← Evidence B
├── REFUTES  ← Evidence C
└── QUALIFIES ← Evidence D
```

---

# 7170. Evidence can be:

```text
experiment
measurement
benchmark
dataset
replication
review
```

---

# 7171. Paper itself may be Artifact containing Evidence

Но:

```text
citation count
```

не Evidence of scientific truth.

---

# 7172. Citation count only:

```text
attention / influence signal
```

---

# 7173. Journal prestige ≠ claim correctness

---

# 7174. Peer review ≠ replication

---

# 7175. Preprint ≠ false

---

# 7176. Published ≠ verified forever

---

# 7177. Therefore Research Observatory must be epistemic, not bibliometric-only

---

# 7178. Evidence independence

Очень важно отличать:

```text
three papers using same dataset
```

от:

```text
three independent replications
```

---

# 7179. Citation dependency graph

Paper B may cite A and reuse same experiment.

Это не independent evidence.

---

# 7180. Evidence lineage

Need:

```text
DERIVED_FROM
```

links.

---

# 7181. Example

```text
Meta-analysis
DERIVED_FROM
Paper A
Paper B
Paper C
```

---

# 7182. Evidence independence can be application attribute

```text
INDEPENDENT
PARTIALLY_DEPENDENT
DERIVED
UNKNOWN
```

---

# 7183. No universal confidence score required

Better expose:

```text
number of independent studies
replications
contradictions
scope
freshness
```

---

# 7184. Review articles

Review Paper = Artifact.

It may contain:

```text
synthesis Claims
```

---

# 7185. Review ≠ source of all underlying Evidence

Should preserve references to original studies.

---

# 7186. Meta-analysis

Can be powerful Evidence.

But context:

```text
inclusion criteria
heterogeneity
publication bias
```

matters.

---

# 7187. System should not flatten meta-analysis into:

```text
final truth
```

---

# 7188. Negative Results

Очень важны.

Need store:

```text
Method failed under Context C
```

---

# 7189. Negative result ≠ method useless universally

---

# 7190. Null result

Example:

```text
No significant improvement observed
```

under specified conditions.

---

# 7191. Store as valid Knowledge

---

# 7192. This prevents repeated wasted experiments

---

# 7193. Retraction

Research source can become:

```text
RETRACTED
```

---

# 7194. Retraction should trigger

```text
dependent Claim review
```

---

# 7195. But retraction ≠ every claim in paper false automatically

---

# 7196. Need reason-aware retraction handling

```text
data issue
duplicate publication
ethical issue
analysis error
```

---

# 7197. Evidence dependency invalidation

If critical Evidence invalidated:

```text
Claim status
```

may become:

```text
REVIEW_REQUIRED
```

---

# 7198. Scientific Claim lifecycle

Application-level:

```text
CANDIDATE
SUPPORTED
CONTESTED
REFUTED
STALE
RETRACTED_SOURCE
```

---

# 7199. Core TruthState still:

```text
YES
NO
UNKNOWN
```

---

# 7200. Scientific lifecycle adds process context

---

# 7201. Researcher Resource

Person profile:

```text
Research Areas
Methods
Datasets
Papers
Experiments
Labs
```

---

# 7202. But authorship ≠ capability automatically

---

# 7203. Coauthor on paper about topic X

supports:

```text
possible domain experience
```

not necessarily:

```text
expert capability
```

---

# 7204. Contribution role matters

If available:

```text
conceptualization
methodology
software
experiments
analysis
```

---

# 7205. Author order differs by field

Do not infer contribution universally.

---

# 7206. ORCID

Strong external identity when explicit.

---

# 7207. Same researcher names

Need conservative entity resolution.

---

# 7208. Never merge only by:

```text
same surname + initials
```

---

# 7209. Researcher capability claim

Example:

```text
Researcher PROVIDES
fiber optic sensing expertise
```

could be INFERENCE supported by:


```text
People
Code
Knowledge
Money
Equipment
Organizations
```

---

# 7729. Research Observatory acceptance summary

It is successful when system can answer:

```text
What is known?
What evidence supports it?
What evidence contradicts it?
What is unknown?
What method could resolve it?
Who/what is needed to test it?
```

---

# 7730. That is fundamentally different from a search engine

---

# 7731. Search engine returns:

```text
documents
```

Research Observatory returns:

```text
structured epistemic state
```

---

# 7732. That state can then drive Projects

---

# 7733. Main invariant set

```text
Paper ≠ Truth.
```

```text
Citation ≠ Evidence of correctness.
```

```text
Agent agreement ≠ scientific consensus.
```

```text
Simulation ≠ experiment.
```

```text
Correlation ≠ causation.
```

```text
One study ≠ universal result.
```

```text
Negative result ≠ useless result.
```

```text
Extraction confidence ≠ scientific confidence.
```

---

# 7734. Architecture Freeze still holds

Research uses existing root types:

```text
ARTIFACT
CLAIM
EVIDENCE
CONCEPT
RESOURCE
ACTION
PROJECT
CONTEXT
```

---

# 7735. No new roots needed for:

```text
Paper
Method
Dataset
Researcher
Experiment
Benchmark
Knowledge Gap
```

---

# 7736. Mapping:

```text
Paper → Artifact
Method → Concept
Dataset → Artifact
Researcher → Resource
Experiment → Action
Benchmark → Artifact/Procedure Package
Knowledge Gap → Derived State
```

---

# 7737. Это третье серьёзное доказательство универсальности IIR Core

---

# 7738. Главный итог

Теперь Innovation OS различает три разных причины, почему Project заблокирован:

```text
не хватает человека
```

```text
не хватает технологии
```

```text
не хватает знания
```

---

# 7739. И каждая причина запускает свой resolver

```text
Talent Resolver
Technology Resolver
Knowledge Resolver
```

---

# 7740. Но все три используют одну архитектуру

```text
Requirement
↔
Provider / Evidence / Resolution
```

---

# 7741. Следующий логичный модуль

Теперь появляется естественный следующий вопрос:

> Даже если мы нашли человека, код и знание — кто оплатит работу, эксперимент, интеграцию или оборудование?

Следующий модуль:

# **Funding, Grants & Consortium Observatory v0.1**

Он должен превратить финансирование из отдельного поиска грантов в ещё один Resource Resolver:

```text
Project
↓
Funding Gap
↓
Grant / Investor / Sponsor / Procurement / Internal Budget
↓
Eligibility
↓
Consortium Requirements
↓
Proposal Project
↓
Award / Rejection Evidence
```

И тогда единый Project Resolver получит уже четыре основных supply-layer:

```text
People
Code
Knowledge
Funding
```

После этого станет возможным автоматически собирать не просто команду или технологический стек, а почти полный **исполняемый проектный пакет**.
contents.title: Research & Knowledge Observatory v0.1 — Papers, Methods, Datasets, Researchers, Experiments & Evidence Graph

contents.content: Да

Продолжаю на русском. Теперь добавляем четвёртый supply-layer — **Funding, Grants & Consortium Observatory v0.1**. Его задача — превратить финансирование из внешнего поиска грантов и инвесторов в структурированный resolver: Project → Funding Gap → Funding Sources → Eligibility → Consortium → Proposal → Decision → Award/Rejection → Evidence → World State Update.

# Funding, Grants & Consortium Observatory v0.1

## 7742. Главный переход

До этого Innovation OS уже умеет искать:

```text id="tqg1sl"
People
Code
Knowledge
```

Но даже если:

```text id="7hhmwj"
человек найден
репозиторий найден
метод известен
```

Project может оставаться невозможным из-за:

```text id="a83joa"
Funding Gap
```

---

# 7743. Поэтому четвёртый Resolver

```text id="mfbyn7"
Project
↓
Funding Need
↓
Funding Sources
↓
Eligibility
↓
Application / Negotiation
↓
Award / Commitment
```

---

# 7744. Главная идея

Финансирование — не отдельная административная функция.

Оно является:

```text id="w2e4qq"
Resource Resolution Problem
```

---

# 7745. Универсальная форма

```text id="4yz2pq"
Project REQUIRES Funding Resource
```

---

# 7746. Funding Resource может быть разным

```text id="4glbma"
Grant
Equity
Loan
Sponsor
Public Procurement
Internal Budget
Prize
Fellowship
Research Contract
Donation
In-kind Contribution
```

---

# 7747. Поэтому Funding Observatory не должен быть только

```text id="45mhy2"
grant search engine
```

---

# 7748. Он должен отвечать:

```text id="q0nl5g"
Каким способом
этот Project может быть профинансирован?
```

---

# 7749. Funding Source = Resource

Например:

```text id="dv1p72"
Grant Programme
```

может быть:

```text id="n6dhzs"
ResourceType.GRANT
```

---

# 7750. Investor / Sponsor / Agency

Это:

```text id="c2dmx0"
ResourceType.ORGANIZATION
```

---

# 7751. Funding Call Document

Это:

```text id="ji6yat"
ARTIFACT
```

---

# 7752. Funding eligibility rule

Это:

```text id="s648eg"
CONSTRAINT
```

---

# 7753. Application

Лучше моделировать как:

```text id="ri1hkx"
PROJECT
```

или Project subtype/application archetype.

---

# 7754. Award

Это не просто text field.

Это:

```text id="zaupal"
DECISION
+
RESOURCE COMMITMENT
```

---

# 7755. Rejection

Тоже Decision/Event.

---

# 7756. Awarded funding ≠ received money

Очень важное различие.

---

# 7757. Lifecycle

```text id="li8azx"
DISCOVERED
↓
ELIGIBLE?
↓
APPLICATION_PREP
↓
SUBMITTED
↓
UNDER_REVIEW
↓
AWARDED / REJECTED
↓
CONTRACTED
↓
AVAILABLE
↓
DISBURSED
↓
CONSUMED
```

---

# 7758. Поэтому Funding Resource имеет temporal lifecycle

---

# 7759. Call open ≠ money available

---

# 7760. Award ≠ cash received

---

# 7761. Cash received ≠ unrestricted money

---

# 7762. Funding may carry:

```text id="4n413q"
purpose restrictions
reporting
co-financing
eligible costs
time window
geography
consortium requirements
```

---

# 7763. Это всё Constraints

---

# 7764. Core pipeline

```text id="pi2t00"
Project
↓
Funding Need
↓
Funding Query Plan
↓
Funding Opportunities
↓
Eligibility Filter
↓
Strategic Fit
↓
Consortium Gap
↓
Proposal Project
↓
Submission
↓
Decision
↓
Funding Resource Update
```

---

# 7765. Funding Gap

Derived object:

```python id="uapzb9"
class FundingGap(BaseModel):
    project_id: UUID

    amount_min: Decimal | None
    amount_max: Decimal | None
    currency: str | None

    required_from: date | None
    required_until: date | None

    eligible_cost_categories: list[str]

    unresolved_dimensions: list[str]
```

---

# 7766. Не всегда известна точная сумма

Можно иметь:

```text id="3vyvmt"
range
```

или:

```text id="4wabg1"
UNKNOWN
```

---

# 7767. Funding Need может быть не только money

Например:

```text id="pws90f"
lab access
GPU credits
cloud credits
staff secondment
equipment donation
```

---

# 7768. Это:

```text id="q9fn1z"
in-kind funding
```

---

# 7769. Поэтому Funding Package может состоять из:

```text id="u1swez"
cash
credits
equipment
staff time
services
```

---

# 7770. Funding Source archetypes

```text id="crkl4i"
PUBLIC_GRANT
RESEARCH_GRANT
INNOVATION_GRANT
EQUITY
VENTURE_CAPITAL
ANGEL
LOAN
SPONSORSHIP
PROCUREMENT
PRIZE
FELLOWSHIP
DONATION
INTERNAL_BUDGET
IN_KIND
```

---

# 7771. Funding source type ≠ business model

One Project may combine several.

---

# 7772. Example Funding Package

```text id="v1jrha"
EU Grant
+
Corporate Sponsor
+
Internal Staff Time
+
Cloud Credits
```

---

# 7773. This is important

because many real projects are:

```text id="ydmixr"
blended finance
```

---

# 7774. Funding Package application model

```python id="4zwxxb"
class FundingPackage(BaseModel):
    project_id: UUID

    funding_option_ids: list[UUID]

    cash_amounts: list[MoneyAmount]
    in_kind_resources: list[UUID]

    uncovered_amount: MoneyRange | None

    conditions: list[UUID]

    unknowns: list[str]
```

---

# 7775. Funding Opportunity

Application-level projection over:

```text id="5ttfru"
Resource
Artifact
Constraints
```

---

# 7776. Opportunity fields

```text id="j9yuug"
provider
call
deadline
budget
funding rate
eligible applicants
eligible regions
eligible costs
project duration
consortium rules
TRL/maturity
topic scope
```

---

# 7777. Call document remains primary Artifact

---

# 7778. Parsed opportunity is derived

---

# 7779. Important invariant

```text id="ec46fe"
Funding database entry
≠
official call text
```

---

# 7780. Official source has priority for verification

---

# 7781. Funding ingestion pipeline

```text id="97xz9f"
Funding Source
↓
Official Call Artifact
↓
Parser
↓
Eligibility Constraints
↓
Funding Opportunity
↓
Verification
```

---

# 7782. Eligibility extraction should be conservative

---

# 7783. Example call says:

```text id="sv8oyj"
Only SMEs established in Germany
```

Create Constraints:

```text id="v3xji3"
organization_type = SME
country = Germany
```

---

# 7784. If legal definition unclear

store:

```text id="xxti1v"
UNKNOWN
```

until verified.

---

# 7785. Eligibility is mostly hard filtering

This should happen before expensive proposal generation.

---

# 7786. Pipeline

```text id="kawvln"
Retrieve
↓
Hard Eligibility
↓
Topic Fit
↓
Funding Fit
↓
Consortium Requirements
↓
Application Cost
```

---

# 7787. Ineligible opportunity

Do not spend LLM/proposal resources.

---

# 7788. UNKNOWN eligibility

→

```text id="1az3l7"
INVESTIGATE
```

not reject automatically.

---

# 7789. Funding Match categories

Could use:

```text id="tkzcxm"
ELIGIBLE
POTENTIALLY_ELIGIBLE
INELIGIBLE
NEEDS_REVIEW
```

---

# 7790. Funding fit and eligibility separate

Project may be eligible but poorly aligned.

---

# 7791. Example

Call allows:

```text id="mvxmzn"
AI projects
```

but specific topic is:

```text id="wjh6xf"
agriculture robotics
```

Project:

```text id="6gvy17"
legal document automation
```

Eligible applicant perhaps yes,

topic fit weak.

---

# 7792. Topic fit is often semantic inference

---

# 7793. Therefore:

```text id="m8yhk8"
Eligibility = deterministic/hard where possible
Topic Fit = evidence-backed semantic analysis
```

---

# 7794. Funding Query Planner

Input:

```text id="xtjwza"
Project Goal
Capabilities
Domain
Location
Organization type
Budget
Timeline
Maturity
```

---

# 7795. Output:

```text id="sc68kf"
query terms
funding categories
jurisdictions
program types
```

---

# 7796. Example

Project:

```text id="an6vmz"
Virtual Technopark
```

may search:

```text id="2tz2u2"
digital innovation
research infrastructure
open science
digital participation
SME innovation
AI
regional development
```

---

# 7797. Query Planner should not overfit project wording

It should map:

```text id="eqkbo5"
Project capabilities
→ funding terminology
```

---

# 7798. Funding ontology

Useful concepts:

```text id="x2iqln"
digitalisation
deep tech
open science
social innovation
research infrastructure
SME innovation
regional development
education
```

---

# 7799. These are Funding Domain Concepts

---

# 7800. Project may map to several funding vocabularies

---

# 7801. Example

Same project could be framed as:

```text id="3ohse8"
R&D
digital infrastructure
skills development
regional innovation
```

---

# 7802. But framing must remain truthful

Do not distort project merely to fit call.

---

# 7803. Funding distortion detector

Very important.

---

# 7804. It asks:

```text id="jot548"
Are we changing Project goal
only because funding is available?
```

---

# 7805. Funding can distort strategy

Example:

```text id="6iy4ag"
grant funds only feature X
```

but Project needs Y.

---

# 7806. System should show:

```text id="l695a2"
Funding Opportunity
would require Goal/Scope change
```

---

# 7807. That change requires Governance

---

# 7808. Funding ≠ authority over mission

---

# 7809. Strategic Fit

Could compare:

```text id="p5g459"
existing Goal
call objectives
required outputs
```

---

# 7810. Output should list:

```text id="5rz6ct"
aligned areas
misaligned areas
required adaptations
```

---

# 7811. No one-dimensional fit score necessary

---

# 7812. Funding rate

Example:

```text id="e1s9om"
70% eligible costs
```

does not mean:

```text id="7m56ym"
70% total project cost
```

if some costs are ineligible.

---

# 7813. Need Funding Cost Model

```text id="m7wbct"
total project budget
eligible cost base
funding rate
own contribution
```

---

# 7814. Example

```text id="e3k0nb"
Total = 1M
Eligible = 800k
Funding rate = 70%
Grant = 560k
```

---

# 7815. Remaining funding gap:

```text id="0qfb0t"
440k
```

---

# 7816. This can trigger blended funding search

---

# 7817. Co-financing constraint

Some grants require:

```text id="cc7y12"
own contribution
```

---

# 7818. That own contribution itself becomes a Funding Gap

---

# 7819. Recursive funding resolution

```text id="dzwtg3"
Grant requires 30% co-financing
↓
Find internal budget / investor / sponsor
```

---

# 7820. This is analogous to recursive capability resolution

---

# 7821. Consortium requirement

Many calls require:

```text id="44ry8d"
N organizations
from M countries
specific role types
```

---

# 7822. Consortium Gap

Derived object.

---

# 7823. Example

Call requires:

```text id="b7qn4b"
3 independent legal entities
from 3 eligible countries
```

Project currently has:

```text id="x8j0sj"
2 partners
```

---

# 7824. Missing:

```text id="hjj561"
one eligible organization
```

---

# 7825. This becomes Resource Gap

```text id="rb3k4i"
Organization Resource required
```

---

# 7826. Consortium Builder

Input:

```text id="gfprld"
Call Constraints
Project Work Packages
Required Capabilities
Current Partners
```

---

# 7827. Output:

```text id="fbd74f"
Consortium Hypotheses
```

---

# 7828. Consortium Hypothesis ≠ commitment

---

# 7829. Very important invariant

```text id="rnp58w"
Candidate partner ≠ interested partner.
```

---

# 7830. Interest/commitment states

```text id="w39n42"
UNKNOWN
CONTACTED
INTERESTED
NEGOTIATING
COMMITTED
DECLINED
```

---

# 7831. But CONTACTED requires actual communication event

---

# 7832. No automatic outreach without authorized workflow

---

# 7833. Consortium coverage

Need satisfy:

```text id="x5ivkc"
eligibility
countries
legal entity types
capabilities
work packages
budget
```

---

# 7834. Example

Work packages:

```text id="pr1krm"
WP1 Research
WP2 Software
WP3 Pilot
WP4 Dissemination
```

---

# 7835. Need resources:

```text id="awkmjy"
University
Software SME
Pilot organization
Communication partner
```

---

# 7836. These role labels may be call-specific

---

# 7837. Underneath they reduce to:

```text id="m56bpc"
Capabilities
Organization types
Constraints
```

---

# 7838. Consortium Builder can reuse Team Builder

But provider type:

```text id="gw42zz"
Organization
```

instead of person.

---

# 7839. Shared abstraction

```text id="9ol1ct"
Coverage Problem
```

---

# 7840. Example

Required capabilities:

```text id="jipawk"
robotics research
pilot deployment
regulatory expertise
dissemination
```

---

# 7841. Candidate organizations cover subsets.

---

# 7842. Consortium algorithm can start with:

```text id="j4na52"
constraint-aware set cover
```

---

# 7843. Later optimization can consider:

```text id="k8fqae"
country balance
budget
prior collaboration
availability
```

---

# 7844. Do not use citation/prestige as universal partner score

---

# 7845. Partner evidence

Could include:

```text id="88szbn"
past projects
capabilities
facilities
papers
software
```

---

# 7846. HN/GitHub/Research Observatories feed Consortium Builder

---

# 7847. Example

Need AI research partner.

Research Observatory finds:

```text id="go113q"
Lab A
```

---

# 7848. Need software implementation partner.

GitHub/HN find:

```text id="op3jd6"
Company B
```

---

# 7849. Need pilot site.

Physical/organization registry finds:

```text id="78673w"
Organization C
```

---

# 7850. This is cross-observatory project assembly

---

# 7851. Proposal Project

Once funding opportunity selected:

```text id="83qu6r"
Application Preparation
```

becomes Project.

---

# 7852. Why separate Project

Because proposal preparation itself requires:

```text id="kw9e41"
tasks
people
deadlines
artifacts
reviews
```

---

# 7853. Proposal Project archetype

```text id="g7w5hm"
GRANT_APPLICATION
INVESTMENT_ROUND
PROCUREMENT_BID
SPONSORSHIP_PROPOSAL
```

---

# 7854. Grant Proposal tasks

Typical:

```text id="s0dmew"
Eligibility validation
Partner confirmation
Work package design
Budget
Impact section
Risk analysis
Submission
```

---

# 7855. Call deadline becomes hard temporal Constraint

---

# 7856. Deadline + lead time

Important:

```text id="u36qz0"
submission deadline
≠
decision deadline
```

---

# 7857. Internal decision may be needed weeks earlier

---

# 7858. Proposal readiness

Derived state:

```text id="l1fnun"
requirements satisfied?
mandatory documents?
partner commitments?
budget complete?
```

---

# 7859. Submission readiness matrix

```text id="4m8nnq"
Eligibility          YES
Partners             UNKNOWN
Budget               YES
Technical Annex      NO
Declarations         YES
```

---

# 7860. This is better than:

```text id="v8jg3w"
85% complete
```

---

# 7861. Mandatory document

Call may require:

```text id="bxkm8u"
financial statements
declarations
CVs
letters
```

---

# 7862. Each is Artifact Requirement

---

# 7863. Document generation

AI can assist drafting.

---

# 7864. But official declarations requiring human/legal authority must not be auto-signed.

---

# 7865. Signature authority

Capability ≠ authority again.

---

# 7866. Proposal Generator

Can compile:

```text id="c5b2ss"
Project data
Work Packages
Evidence
Budget
Partners
```

into draft sections.

---

# 7867. But draft:

```text id="mzgdmf"
Artifact
```

not submission.

---

# 7868. Submission requires authorized Decision/Action.

---

# 7869. Proposal consistency checker

Very useful.

Check:

```text id="y85ry5"
work package ↔ budget
milestones ↔ tasks
partner ↔ capability
impact ↔ outputs
```

---

# 7870. Example inconsistency

WP3 assigned to Partner C,

but:

```text id="8swopg"
Partner C has no relevant capability evidence
```

---

# 7871. Flag for review.

---

# 7872. Budget compiler

Project Resource Plan:

```text id="7e00wr"
staff
equipment
travel
subcontracting
compute
```

→

```text id="db2ckg"
Funding Budget Structure
```

---

# 7873. But funding rules may define categories differently

---

# 7874. Budget Mapping

```text id="g16ick"
Project Resource Type
→
Call Eligible Cost Category
```

---

# 7875. Mapping may be ambiguous

Store UNKNOWN.

---

# 7876. Do not invent eligibility

---

# 7877. Funding Rule Engine

Can represent rules:

```text id="hw954e"
IF cost_type = equipment
AND depreciation only
THEN eligible_fraction = ...
```

---

# 7878. But v0.1 should focus on straightforward rules

---

# 7879. Complex legal/financial interpretation

requires review.

---

# 7880. Funding compliance

Awarded funding introduces:

```text id="8sg0y2"
reporting
milestones
eligible spending
procurement rules
```

---

# 7881. Funding Observatory should continue after award

---

# 7882. Lifecycle not ending at:

```text id="m2dh67"
AWARDED
```

---

# 7883. Post-award monitoring

```text id="53d71a"
budget consumption
milestones
reporting deadlines
deliverables
```

---

# 7884. Resource Accounting Engine handles expenditures

Funding Observatory handles:

```text id="q4sqh1"
funding conditions
```

---

# 7885. Example

Grant says:

```text id="sxt6x7"
funds available until 31 Dec 2028
```

---

# 7886. After date:

```text id="zy9v18"
unused allocation may expire
```

---

# 7887. Expiring Funding Resource

Important event.

---

# 7888. Funding Event types

```text id="rm6bpj"
CALL_OPENED
CALL_UPDATED
DEADLINE_CHANGED
APPLICATION_SUBMITTED
AWARD_GRANTED
APPLICATION_REJECTED
CONTRACT_SIGNED
PAYMENT_RECEIVED
FUNDING_EXPIRED
```

---

# 7889. CALL_UPDATED

May affect eligibility.

---

# 7890. If official call changes:

```text id="sj4sdq"
recalculate affected matches
```

---

# 7891. Funding Match history preserved

---

# 7892. Never silently replace prior eligibility result

---

# 7893. Versioned call Artifact

```text id="ckh2k0"
Call v1
Call v2
```

---

# 7894. Project eligibility against each version

may differ.

---

# 7895. Funding deadline watch

This is naturally event-driven.

---

# 7896. Project may subscribe to:

```text id="duvl2v"
funding opportunities
```

matching its capability graph.

---

# 7897. But don't notify for every remotely related grant

Need relevance filtering.

---

# 7898. Funding relevance dimensions

```text id="4h2foj"
Eligibility
Topic
Budget
Timeline
Maturity
Geography
Consortium burden
```

---

# 7899. User should see these dimensions separately.

---

# 7900. Application Cost

A grant is not free to pursue.

Proposal preparation consumes:

```text id="j4q1d2"
time
staff
consulting
opportunity cost
```

---

# 7901. Need Application Cost estimate

---

# 7902. Example

Grant max €50k

but application requires:

```text id="yco8gi"
200 staff hours
```

---

# 7903. May be unattractive relative to alternatives.

---

# 7904. But system should show trade-off,

not decide universally.

---

# 7905. Funding Acquisition Cost

Components:

```text id="q1fdeg"
discovery
eligibility analysis
proposal preparation
consortium formation
reporting overhead
```

---

# 7906. Funding Friction

Could be qualitative dimensions:

```text id="qu8pt3"
application complexity
reporting burden
cash-flow delay
co-financing burden
```

# 8161. Proposal Artifact lineage

```text id="yl7mq7"
draft v1
DERIVED_FROM
project state
```

references:

```text id="ref7xx"
v1
```

and updated evidence.

# 8163. Submitted proposal snapshot immutable.

# 8164. Funding acceptance tests

### Test 1

Project meets all explicit rules.

Expected:

```text id="918ypq"
Hypothesis only
```

```text id="wgd5he"
correct uncovered Funding Gap
```

# 8172. Test 9

# 8174. Test 11

```text id="d1d48b"
ignored as instruction
```

# 8179. Funding Gold Dataset initial size

Enough:

```text id="9kwu28"
30 opportunities
20 projects
100 eligibility rules
50 project-opportunity pairs
```

# 8180. Metrics

```text id="y2pzgr"
Funding Retrieval Recall
Funding Retrieval Precision
Eligibility Error Rate
Unknown Handling Accuracy
Deadline Extraction Accuracy
```

# 8181. Consortium metrics later:

```text id="cddu9z"
coverage accuracy
constraint violation rate
```

---

# 8182. Proposal quality metrics later:

```text id="jxfqsn"
missing mandatory section
unsupported claim count
budget inconsistency count
```

# 8183. Outcome metrics

Not:

```text id="jnhvmi"
win rate only
```

---

# 8184. More useful:

```text id="2d8ctr"
eligibility correctness
submission completeness
estimate accuracy
application effort
```

# 8185. Award outcome remains external event.

---

# 8186. Funding Observatory self-improvement

```text id="9g2z8x"
Call Parsing
↓
Eligibility Review
↓
Corrections
↓
Rule Improvement
↓
Benchmark
↓
New Version
```

# 8187. Proposal self-improvement

```text id="z7xo9k"
Draft
↓
Human Review
↓
Correction Reasons
↓
Template/Prompt Update
```

---

# 8188. Rejection learning

```text id="2y5wep"
Rejection Feedback
↓
Contextual Lesson
```

not:

```text id="acivhw"
universal rule
```

---

# 8189. Funding Memory Package

After each application:

```text id="9j26sn"
call
eligibility
proposal
budget
partners
outcome
feedback
```

---

# 8190. Similar future calls can reuse this memory.

---

# 8191. Stale reuse check

If new call differs:

```text id="3n7h81"
do not blindly reuse old requirements
```

---

# 8192. Funding Claim freshness

Deadline and budget change rapidly.

---

# 8193. Therefore high freshness requirement.

---

# 8194. Organization legal form changes slowly,

but still needs current evidence where critical.

---

# 8195. Funding source trust

Official call document is strongest source for:

```text id="0s0rj5"
deadline
budget
eligibility
```

---

# 8196. Aggregator can be discovery source only.

---

# 8197. Critical invariant

```text id="9523hw"
Aggregator ≠ authoritative call source.
```

---

# 8198. Secondary source can still be useful if official source inaccessible,

but status must be clear.

---

# 8199. Funding Observatory and Strategic Engine

Funding option affects:

```text id="wp04x4"
timing
scope
control
risk
future options
```

---

# 8200. Strategy should therefore consider Funding Option as strategic branch.

---

# 8201. Example

```text id="i58d02"
Wait 6 months for grant
```

vs:

```text id="9tzk0r"
take investor funding now
```

---

# 8202. These have different:

```text id="ba06la"
time
ownership
scope freedom
risk
```

---

# 8203. Funding Resolver supplies facts.

Strategy Engine chooses through governance.

---

# 8204. Funding Observatory and Causal Engine

Can evaluate:

```text id="a4ye7s"
Will funding condition create project delay?
```

---

# 8205. Or:

```text id="1yd7yu"
Will reporting burden consume scarce staff capacity?
```

---

# 8206. These are causal hypotheses.

---

# 8207. Funding may create second-order effects.

---

# 8208. Example

Grant creates:

```text id="gzz20c"
new hiring capacity
```

but also:

```text id="80nlkr"
administrative overhead
```

---

# 8209. Both should be modeled.

---

# 8210. Funding Observatory and Organization Engine

Large grant may require:

```text id="u4hsip"
Program Office
Financial Reporting
Project Management
```

---

# 8211. These can create Organizational Capability Gaps.

---

# 8212. Thus funding can trigger organization formation.

---

# 8213. Funding Observatory and Resource Economy

Awarded grant becomes:

```text id="68n89e"
Resource Budget
```

---

# 8214. Resource Accounting allocates:

```text id="dyjko8"
money
staff
equipment
```

---

# 8215. Funding conditions constrain allocations.

---

# 8216. This is more precise than one balance number.

---

# 8217. Funding Observatory and Technopedia

Public pages could describe:

```text id="jzdy74"
funding programs
eligibility concepts
application archetypes
```

---

# 8218. But individual private proposals remain private.

---

# 8219. Funding Knowledge Page

Could show:

```text id="as6umd"
Programme
Current calls
Eligible organizations
Typical project types
Official sources
```

---

# 8220. Historical calls can remain archived.

---

# 8221. Funding archetype packages

Reusable patterns:

```text id="r7c0t1"
EU Consortium Proposal
Regional SME Innovation Grant
Research Infrastructure Grant
```

---

# 8222. Each package may include:

```text id="2wn007"
checklist
work package template
budget mapping
review procedure
```

---

# 8223. But package does not replace call-specific rules.

---

# 8224. Proposal Procedure Package

Could compile into Procedural Graph:

```text id="x2m5fw"
Validate eligibility
↓
Form consortium
↓
Draft technical plan
↓
Build budget
↓
Review
↓
Submit
```

---

# 8225. This is direct integration with Workflow Engine.

---

# 8226. Deadline path

Procedural Graph can compute:

```text id="1ouimr"
latest safe start date
```

based on expected task durations.

---

# 8227. If impossible:

```text id="emhtpd"
Deadline Feasibility Gap
```

---

# 8228. Then Strategy may:

```text id="rr0v9o"
skip
defer
reduce scope
```

subject to governance.

---

# 8229. Funding Resolver generalization

Now Project Resolver has four major resource classes:

```text id="ftahyg"
People
Code
Knowledge
Funding
```

---

# 8230. Unified view

```text id="l7brzf"
Project
│
├── Capability Gaps
├── Knowledge Gaps
├── Funding Gaps
└── Consortium Gaps
```

---

# 8231. Each Gap routes to specialized resolver.

---

# 8232. Talent Resolver

Finds:

```text id="j0n1v1"
people
```

---

# 8233. Technology Resolver

Finds:

```text id="wl66yu"
software
```

---

# 8234. Knowledge Resolver

Finds:

```text id="3ax1ip"
methods/evidence
```

---

# 8235. Funding Resolver

Finds:

```text id="fnck7m"
capital/resources
```

---

# 8236. Consortium Resolver

Finds:

```text id="a7dm7q"
organizations
```

---

# 8237. This means Organization itself is also supply type.

---

# 8238. Full Project Assembly begins to emerge

```text id="50lcpt"
Goal
↓
Capabilities
↓
People
Code
Knowledge
Funding
Organizations
```

---

# 8239. Missing fifth major dimension now becomes obvious

Even after money is found:

```text id="ymjggg"
where and with what physical resources
will project actually run?
```

---

# 8240. That leads to:

```text id="55zg31"
Labs
Equipment
Manufacturing
Facilities
Logistics
```

---

# 8241. Architecture Freeze again holds

Funding domain uses:

```text id="zuxw89"
RESOURCE
ARTIFACT
CONSTRAINT
PROJECT
DECISION
EVENT
CLAIM
EVIDENCE
```

---

# 8242. No new root types needed for:

```text id="9z0ofx"
Grant
Funding Opportunity
Proposal
Consortium
Funding Gap
Award
```

---

# 8243. Mapping:

```text id="xv9zen"
Grant → Resource
Call → Artifact
Eligibility → Constraint
Proposal → Project/Artifact set
Consortium → Organization/Team view
Award → Decision + Resource commitment
Funding Gap → Derived State
```

---

# 8244. Главные invariants

```text id="2m5euq"
Funding opportunity ≠ funding.
```

```text id="pzspfn"
Application ≠ award.
```

```text id="e6tqu3"
Award ≠ cash received.
```

```text id="g1yl84"
Eligible ≠ good strategic fit.
```

```text id="l5prlg"
Candidate partner ≠ committed partner.
```

```text id="lp567q"
Funding availability ≠ unrestricted spending.
```

```text id="dus8oa"
Aggregator ≠ authoritative source.
```

```text id="0ds7wv"
AI draft ≠ authorized submission.
```

---

# 8245. Главный результат

После Funding Observatory Innovation OS впервые может собрать почти полный проектный пакет:

```text id="5gww49"
Problem
↓
Capabilities
↓
People
↓
Code
↓
Knowledge
↓
Funding
↓
Organizations
```

---

# 8246. То есть система уже может перейти от вопроса:

```text id="h4u6oh"
Есть ли идея?
```

к вопросу:

```text id="487ux7"
Можно ли реально собрать
исполняемый проект?
```

---

# 8247. Но пока отсутствует один критический слой:

```text id="63d724"
physical execution
```

---

# 8248. Следующий модуль

Логично перейти к:

# **Physical Infrastructure, Labs, Equipment, Manufacturing & Logistics Observatory v0.1**

Он должен добавить:

```text id="h88wmm"
Labs
Equipment
Facilities
Manufacturers
Materials
Machine Time
Operators
Calibration
Transport
Storage
Logistics
```

и научить систему понимать, что физическая capability часто является не одной машиной, а композицией:

```text id="qqjyd2"
Equipment
+
Operator
+
Consumables
+
Calibration
+
Safety
+
Time Slot
+
Location
```

После этого Project Resolver получит уже полный основной набор:

```text id="q1evrk"
People
Code
Knowledge
Funding
Physical Resources
```

и Innovation OS сможет собирать не только цифровой, но и настоящий физически исполняемый проект.
contents.title: Funding, Grants & Consortium Observatory v0.1 — Funding Resolver, Eligibility, Consortium & Proposal Engine

contents.content: Да

Продолжаю на русском. Теперь добавляем пятый основной supply-layer — **Physical Infrastructure, Labs, Equipment, Manufacturing & Logistics Observatory v0.1**. Этот модуль переводит Innovation OS из чисто цифровой среды в физический мир: лаборатории, оборудование, производственные мощности, материалы, операторы, калибровка, логистика и реальные ограничения времени/места.

# Physical Infrastructure, Labs, Equipment, Manufacturing & Logistics Observatory v0.1

## 8249. Главный переход

До этого Project Resolver уже мог искать:

```text
People
Code
Knowledge
Funding
Organizations
```

Но многие проекты всё равно невозможно выполнить, если отсутствует:

```text
Physical Capability
```

Например:

```text
станок
лаборатория
робот
датчик
печь
склад
испытательная установка
транспорт
материал
оператор
```

---

# 8250. Поэтому следующий общий слой

```text
Project
↓
Physical Requirement
↓
Physical Resource Resolution
↓
Reservation
↓
Execution
↓
Measurement / Verification
```

---

# 8251. Главная идея

Физическая capability почти никогда не равна:

```text
одна машина
```

Чаще она равна:

```text
Equipment
+
Operator
+
Consumables
+
Calibration
+
Safety Conditions
+
Time Slot
+
Location
+
Procedure
```

---

# 8252. Это принципиально

Например:

```text
есть 5-axis CNC
```

не означает:

```text
можно изготовить нужную деталь завтра
```

---

# 8253. Почему

Может отсутствовать:

```text
оператор
оснастка
материал
свободный слот
калибровка
правильная точность
допуск по размерам
```

---

# 8254. Поэтому Physical Resource ≠ Physical Capability

Правильнее:

```text
Physical Resource Bundle
PROVIDES
Physical Capability
```

---

# 8255. Основные Resource Types

```text
LAB
EQUIPMENT
FACILITY
MACHINE
ROBOT
SENSOR
VEHICLE
WAREHOUSE
MANUFACTURING_LINE
ORGANIZATION
PERSON
MATERIAL_STOCK
```

---

# 8256. Core IIR остаётся тем же

Physical domain использует:

```text
RESOURCE
ACTION
PROJECT
CONSTRAINT
EVENT
CLAIM
EVIDENCE
ARTIFACT
CONTEXT
```

---

# 8257. Новый core root не нужен

Например:

```text
Machine → Resource subtype
Lab → Resource subtype
Material Batch → Resource subtype / tracked lot
Work Order → Project/Action structure
Measurement → Evidence + Artifact
```

---

# 8258. Physical Requirement

Project может требовать:

```text
milling
laser cutting
SEM imaging
temperature cycling
battery testing
3D printing
clean-room assembly
```

---

# 8259. Это capability concepts

Например:

```text
5-axis CNC machining
```

а конкретный станок:

```text
Resource
```

---

# 8260. Правильная связь

```text
Machine
PROVIDES
5-axis CNC machining
```

Но только в определённых пределах.

---

# 8261. Ограничения capability

Например:

```text
max part size
tolerance
materials
spindle speed
axis travel
temperature range
pressure range
```

---

# 8262. Поэтому capability должна иметь qualifiers/context

---

# 8263. Пример

Не:

```text
Machine X provides milling
```

а:

```text
Machine X provides
5-axis milling
for aluminum/titanium
up to dimensions D
under tolerance T
```

---

# 8264. Physical Capability Contract

Можно определить application model:

```python
class PhysicalCapabilityContract(BaseModel):
    capability_id: UUID
    resource_id: UUID

    supported_materials: list[str]
    min_dimensions: dict | None
    max_dimensions: dict | None

    tolerances: dict | None

    required_operator_capability_ids: list[UUID]

    calibration_required: bool
    safety_requirements: list[str]

    location_id: UUID | None
```

---

# 8265. Не все поля универсальны

Поэтому domain-specific capability profiles допустимы.

---

# 8266. Но базовая идея универсальна

```text
Capability
+
Operational Envelope
```

---

# 8267. Operational Envelope

Это диапазон условий, в которых resource реально может выполнять capability.

---

# 8268. Example

Robot arm:

```text
payload ≤ 10 kg
reach ≤ 1.3 m
temperature 5–40°C
```

---

# 8269. Если Project требует:

```text
15 kg payload
```

это hard NO.

---

# 8270. UNKNOWN limit

Если payload limit неизвестен:

```text
UNKNOWN
```

не PASS.

---

# 8271. Physical matching pipeline

```text
Requirement
↓
Candidate Equipment
↓
Hard Physical Constraints
↓
Availability
↓
Operator
↓
Consumables
↓
Calibration
↓
Location / Logistics
↓
Verification
```

---

# 8272. Это существенно сложнее job/repo matching

Потому что физическая capability:

```text
time-dependent
location-dependent
state-dependent
```

---

# 8273. State-dependent example

Same machine may be:

```text
AVAILABLE
BUSY
MAINTENANCE
FAILED
UNCALIBRATED
UNKNOWN
```

---

# 8274. ResourceAvailability расширяется domain state

Но canonical availability может оставаться coarse-grained.

---

# 8275. Physical State

Application-level:

```text
READY
BUSY
MAINTENANCE
FAILED
CALIBRATION_DUE
OFFLINE
UNKNOWN
```

---

# 8276. Availability ≠ health

A machine can be:

```text
AVAILABLE
```

but:

```text
CALIBRATION_DUE
```

---

# 8277. Therefore separate dimensions

```text
availability
health
verification/calibration state
```

---

# 8278. Time slot matters

Physical capability has capacity schedule.

---

# 8279. Example

Lab instrument available:

```text
Tuesday 14:00–18:00
```

but not:

```text
Monday
```

---

# 8280. Capacity becomes temporal resource

---

# 8281. Reservation object

Application-level:

```python
class ResourceReservation(BaseModel):
    resource_id: UUID
    project_id: UUID

    start_time: datetime
    end_time: datetime

    amount: Decimal | None

    status: str
```

---

# 8282. Reservation lifecycle

```text
REQUESTED
HELD
CONFIRMED
ACTIVE
COMPLETED
CANCELLED
EXPIRED
```

---

# 8283. Reservation ≠ assignment

Assignment:

```text
who is responsible
```

Reservation:

```text
which physical capacity is held
```

---

# 8284. Example

Machine reserved for Project A

but operator assigned separately.

---

# 8285. Operator requirement

A machine may require:

```text
certified operator
```

---

# 8286. Then composite capability:

```text
Machine
+
Person
```

---

# 8287. Example

CNC machine:

```text
Equipment Resource
```

Operator:

```text
Person Resource
```

Certification:

```text
Capability / Evidence
```

---

# 8288. Thus physical resolver reuses Talent Resolver

---

# 8289. Consumables

Examples:

```text
gas
chemicals
filament
cutting tools
batteries
sample holders
```

---

# 8290. Consumable availability

Can block physical action.

---

# 8291. Material Resource

Need distinguish:

```text
Material Type
```

from:

```text
Material Batch
```

---

# 8292. Material Type

Concept:

```text
Aluminum 7075
```

---

# 8293. Material Batch

Tracked Resource/Artifact lot:

```text
batch ID
quantity
supplier
certificate
```

---

# 8294. Why batch matters

For reproducibility/quality:

```text
material batch
```

can affect result.

---

# 8295. Certificate of Analysis

Artifact.

---

# 8296. Traceability

```text
Batch
→ Process
→ Part
→ Test
```

---

# 8297. Manufacturing lineage

Important for:

```text
quality
recall
reproducibility
```

---

# 8298. Physical Artifact

Manufactured part is both:

```text
physical object
```

and semantically can be:

```text
ARTIFACT
```

---

# 8299. But operationally useful to also represent it as Resource if reused

---

# 8300. Example

Prototype part:

```text
Artifact
```

Test fixture reused repeatedly:

```text
Resource
```

---

# 8301. Build process

```text
Raw Material
↓
Manufacturing Actions
↓
Part Artifact
```

---

# 8302. Manufacturing Process

Can be:

```text
Concept
+
Procedural Graph
```

---

# 8303. Example

```text
CNC milling
heat treatment
surface finish
inspection
```

---

# 8304. Process Route

```text
Operation 10
↓
Operation 20
↓
Operation 30
```

---

# 8305. This is manufacturing procedural graph

---

# 8306. Work Order

Could be:

```text
Project subtype
```

or structured Action bundle.

---

# 8307. Work Order contains

```text
part
quantity
route
resources
deadline
verification
```

---

# 8308. BOM — Bill of Materials

Could be Artifact + structured application model.

---

# 8309. BOM lines

```text
part
quantity
unit
source
version
```

---

# 8310. BOM versioning critical

---

# 8311. Design Artifact

CAD model:

```text
Artifact
```

---

# 8312. Manufacturing capability requirement derived from CAD

Example:

```text
feature geometry
material
tolerance
surface roughness
```

---

# 8313. CAD itself should not be parsed into truth blindly

Need extraction/verification pipeline.

---

# 8314. Manufacturing feasibility check

```text
CAD / BOM
↓
Process Planning
↓
Machine Capability Matching
↓
Tooling / Material
↓
Cost / Lead Time
```

---

# 8315. This becomes Physical Resolver.
